description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It provides mechanisms for validating data types against expected ranges, regex patterns, or custom functions, and managing multiple validators.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for representing expected values of a type T, supporting discrete sets, ranges, and regex patterns, with validation methods.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class for validating values of type T using expected values or custom functions, inheriting from ValidatorBase.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a value of type T or const char* against the expected criteria.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the ValidationManager, either by expected values or a custom function.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a logging function for validation messages.
